declarations.description:
One facet of a filter sidebar, like the facets of Datadog, Sentry and Kibana: an attribute's values with how many
records have each, to include or exclude from a search. A sidebar stacks one element per attribute.

Each value has a checkbox that includes it, an Only button that makes it the only value included, and an Exclude
button that filters it out (Datadog's `-service:x`); an excluded value is struck through and its button includes it
again. Clear empties the selection. `include` and `exclude` hold the values; every change fires a cancelable
`filter-change` with the selection as it is about to become, then updates them, so cancel it to keep the facet
controlled.

Values are sorted by count (`sort`), counts are shortened in the page's language, `searchable` adds a field that
filters a long list, and `max-items` shows the first values with a button to show the rest. The title is a
disclosure button that collapses the facet (`open`).

The Only and Exclude buttons appear on hover and focus, but are always in the tab order and named for screen readers
("Only checkout"); each checkbox is named by its value and count, and says when the value is excluded.

members.name: label
members.description: The facet's title: the attribute it filters by.

members.name: values
members.description: The values. As an attribute, a JSON array of `{ value, label, count }`.

members.name: include
members.description: The values included. As an attribute, values separated by `;`.

members.name: exclude
members.description: The values excluded. As an attribute, values separated by `;`.

members.name: searchable
members.description: Adds a field that filters the values.

members.name: maxItems
members.description: How many values show before a button reveals the rest. 0 shows them all.

members.name: sort
members.description: The order of the values: largest count first, by label, or as given.

members.name: countFormat
members.description: `Intl.NumberFormat` options for the counts, as an object or JSON. Defaults to the compact notation (`12K`).

members.name: commit
members.description: Announces the selection about to be set, then sets it unless the event was cancelled.

events.name: filter-change
events.description: The user changed the selection. `detail` is `include` and `exclude` as they are about to become. Cancelable.

events.name: toggle
events.description: The facet was opened or collapsed by the user.
